tools.name: list_business_checking
tools.description: Compare US business checking accounts. Returns up to `limit` rows (default 7, max 20) plus total_matches and next_offset (pass as offset to page). A missing field means not offered or not published. Give each application_url to the user exactly as returned.

entity_types_accepted.description: Must accept ALL: llc, s_corp, c_corp, sole_prop, partnership, nonprofit

has_active_promotion.description: true: only listings with a current promotion (rows include promotions); false: none. Recorded for some banks only

apy_min.description: Min best-case rate (apy_max) as a decimal, 0.02 = 2%. apy_default is the standard rate

integrations_any.description: Integrates with ANY of these, e.g. quickbooks, xero, gusto, stripe, plaid (aliases like qbo work)

min_limits.description: Needs value >= n on any plan. Keys: sub_accounts, free_cash_deposit_usd, free_wires, monthly_cash_limit_usd

rank_industries.description: RANK ONLY, never excludes. ecommerce, retail_storefront, restaurant_food_service, content_creator_solopreneur, professional_services, real_estate, healthcare_practice, construction_trades, trucking_logistics, agriculture, saas_tech, nonprofit, small_business_digital_first

rank_profiles.description: RANK ONLY, never excludes. early_stage_startup, vc_backed, bootstrapped_solopreneur, established_smb, high_growth, side_hustle

sort.description: monthly_fee_asc, monthly_fee_desc, apy_max_desc, apy_default_desc, minimum_opening_deposit_asc, free_transactions_desc, product_name_asc

fields.description: Replaces the defaults (institution_name, product_name, monthly_fee, minimum_opening_deposit, insurance_type, apy_max, apy_default, free_transactions_per_month). Others: plan_tiers, promotions, entity_types_accepted, available_states, cash_deposit_fee_per_100, outgoing_domestic_wire_fee, rtp_network, atm_network, apy_tiers. A bad name returns all valid names

tools.name: search_facts
tools.description: Full-text search of fee and feature details across banks (e.g. 'zelle', 'overdraft'). Returns the best snippets per bank with application_url. Terms are ANDed; 'or', "quotes", -exclude work.

slugs.description: Only these listing_slugs; banks without a hit go in no_match

topic.description: fees, payment_rails, cash_handling, cards_and_atm, online_banking, fraud_protection, account_management, platform_integrations or other

tools.name: fees_by_type
tools.description: Compare specific fees across banks. Returns each bank's fee rows (amount, unit, free allowance, waiver, tiers).

fee_types.description: 1-3 of: monthly_maintenance, overdraft, non_sufficient_funds, account_opening, account_closing, minimum_balance, excess_transaction, atm_foreign, wire_domestic_outgoing, wire_domestic_incoming, wire_international_outgoing, wire_international_incoming, cash_deposit, paper_statement, dormancy, returned_item, stop_payment, card_replacement, foreign_transaction, other

plan.description: Plan name; default is the default plan

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Detail on 1-4 listings by listing_slug. Pick sections; detail_has shows what else exists.

sections.description: summary, tiers, fees, features, promotions. Default summary, tiers
